perks.name: Transcendent Moment
perks.desc: Final blows grant bonus stats based on the weapon's damage type alignment. Light elements grant stability and handling. Dark elements grant range and aim assist. While Transcendent, this weapon gets both bonuses.

perks.name: Recycled Energy
perks.desc: Reloading after defeating targets grants energy to your lowest charged ability.

perks.name: Perpetual Motion

perks.name: Proximity Power

perks.name: Grave Robber

perks.name: Adagio
perks.desc: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for a brief time.

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.desc: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Eye of the Storm
perks.desc: This weapon becomes more accurate and boosts handling as your health gets lower.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Burning Ambition
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.

perks.name: Bray Legacy
perks.desc: Damage with this weapon generates a small amount of ability energy for the one closest to a full charge.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 148 from 5 August 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/3S0TObWihybmZdCLM6wIUw?si=cf08fccbb9d44fa7) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing Minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly with a Solar build. We've not seen a new rapid fire solar auto rifle since Beyond Light - the frame provides a useful ×0.8 reload animation multiplier when reloading from an empty mag. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats are decent - d2foundry.gg calculates that 25 Range equates to 14.50m hipfire and 23.20m when ADS before damage falloff, 42 Stability is ×1.1094 flinch resist at base, 30 Handling is 0.44s ready, 0.33s ADS and 0.40s stow speed, and 45 Reload Speed is a 1.89s reload (1.51s when the mag's empty) . Ammo Generation is 52, Recoil Direction is 50, and Zoom is 16. With the barrel perk, bump up to recoil control on controller or add Handling for M+KB. The high RPM makes High-Caliber Rounds great, but any of the combat effect or reload boosting options will work. In the first trait perk column, Heal Clip can be a literal lifesaver providing Cure ×2 to you and ×1 to teammates within 15m when you reload within 5.3s of a kill. On ability-spamming builds, Recycled Energy might also be worth a look, synergising with the origin trail to refill both your ability closest to, and furthest from a full charge. Burning Ambition inflicts 10 scorch on enemies with 29 hits (26 when enhanced), so could fit nicely into a solar build. The Bray Legacy Origin Trait is solid in PvE, generating around 0.2% energy per hit for whichever ability is closest to a full charge. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
